issues.explanation: Chapter 14 says 刘备 is ashamed and wants to kill himself after his family is captured, but Chapter 15 opens with 张飞 wanting to kill himself. This changes the suicidal character and makes 刘备’s subsequent persuasion confusing.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the opening to 刘备欲自刎, or revise Chapter 14 so that 张飞 is clearly the character who wants to die.
